## Elephant Network VERSION

Download the signed Android, Windows, or macOS artifact from the assets attached
to this release. Verify it against `SHA256SUMS` before installation.

This GPLv3 release is built from tag
[`vVERSION`](https://github.com/joyefrck/ElephantNetwork/tree/vVERSION). The
repository contains the license, modification notice, upstream history, and
build instructions corresponding to these binaries.

Direct in-place upgrades are released only after the Android signing-certificate
gate and the platform cleanup acceptance suite have passed.
